purpose: Evidence-backed implementation capability inventory used to gate normal levels.

semantics.background: The fightscene ID is executable. fightscene_01/03 use imported originals; fightscene_02/04 intentionally fall back to fightscene_01 until presentation restoration.
semantics.enemyModel: The enemy has a table-driven mechanics profile. Missing Spine art intentionally uses the runtime geometry fallback and remains presentation backlog.
semantics.heroFamily: The family has a production candidate/gear/unit or level-5 fusion path. Recommendation support is informative and is not itself a hard runtime gate.
semantics.preparation: The Cocos loader consumes each level's recovered staticBricks and each round's coinRewards. Static batches are selected only under the recovered first-challenge/forever-static condition; otherwise the shared dynamic draw path is used.
semantics.verifiedPlayable: Every recovered level is intentionally exposed by MainLevelFlow and passes the all-level schedule/profile contract. This does not claim matched visual fidelity or default-account balance clearance.
